h1.en: How Reynolds number arranges a note that only repeats concrete pump integral piston φ210
h1.zh: 《Reynolds number》怎样安排一篇只重复concrete pump integral piston φ210的笔记

directAnswer.en: For concrete pump integral piston φ210, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Reynolds number. Reynolds number only lends its headings. A φ210 integral piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai one-piece piston page. The unit is a piece. Material is a missing field. No published pump page names φ210 as its piston.
directAnswer.zh: 写concrete pump integral piston φ210时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Reynolds number》借数字。《Reynolds number》只出借标题。 φ210 整体活塞是邢台整体活塞页上的一条外径。单位是个。材料是缺字段。没有已公布泵页把 φ210 写成自己的活塞。

body.en: “Definition” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. The integral piston page lists φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250, sold per piece, as replacement parts rather than OEM parts of other brands. This note is only φ210. Rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane are printed on the split-piston page, not as a material for this integral row. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. φ210 is not on the split-piston list. Do not switch the order to a split set. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “定义”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 整体活塞页列出 φ150, φ160, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ205, φ210, φ220, φ225, φ230 and φ250，按个供货，并写明是替换件，不是其他品牌原厂件。本文只写 φ210。橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯印在分体活塞页上，不是这一整体活塞行的材料。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。φ210 不在分体活塞清单里。不要改成订分体套件。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Use “Derivation” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write integral piston, φ210, and the quantity in pieces. Do not add a material the page does not print. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 用“推导”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明整体活塞、φ210 和个数。不要补上页面没有印的材料。 标题到此为止。
